title: noah-martinez-soc2-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-07
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 evidence / vendor reviews / policy TODOs

Morning plan:
- 9:00 sync with Priya (evidence ingestion pipeline) - confirm list of missing artifacts for CC6/CC7
- 10:30 call w/ Maya to review vendor attestation matrix (AWS KMS + HashiCorp) - decide 'acceptable evidence' column
- Block: gather screenshots for IAM user lifecycle demo

Top priority items:
1) Evidence: key rotation logs for KMS (customer key usage) - need logs from 2025-12 through 2026-02. Ticket SEC-342 opened. Action: request export from infra (release-engineering) by EOD Thu.
2) Vendor review: HashiCorp Vault attestation gap - missing L3 pen-test report. Add to vendor follow-up list and ask vendor for scope. Assign to Maya.
3) Policy TODO: Update "Third-Party Risk" policy to include vendor attestation retention (2 years). Draft new section and link to Confluence page. Owner: Priya.

Quick reminders / notes:
- Evidence file naming convention: soc2_evidence_<control>_<YYYY-MM-DD>_<owner>.pdf - ensure infra team follows
- For access reviews add note to HR to provide terminated employee list for 2025 Q4 (needed for ACCESS-2 control)
- Need to capture demo video (screen + narration) for privileged access workflow. Est 15-20m. Record after 2pm.

Open questions:
- Do we accept vendor SOC2 Type II reports with subservice orgs? check legal (Slack: #security-compliance)
- How to handle redaction for client-sensitive logs in shared evidence repo? Option: redacted export + signed attestation from data owner.

Checklist (today):
[ ] Request KMS logs export (SEC-342)
[ ] Follow up w/ HashiCorp on pen-test scope (assign Maya)
[ ] Draft/commit Third-Party Risk policy update
[ ] Record privileged access demo video
[ ] Upload existing evidence PDFs to evidence-redwood S3 (confirm perms)

Slack threads / refs:
- convo: #soc2-evidence (link to pinned items)
- jira: SEC-342, SOC2-118
- confluence: /display/SOC2/Evidence+Index

Notes to self:
- Keep notes terse - these go into Confluence later as formal evidence entries
- If infra can't pull logs, escalate to SRE lead (Oliver Garcia)

End of day follow-up (today):
- 4:30 quick check-in with Priya to confirm progress
- If KMS logs delayed, prepare mitigation plan (alternative evidence: key-rotation policy + screenshots of rotation process)

Misc:
- Attached: none yet - will upload PDFs to shared drive under shared_drives/security-and-compliance/soc2/evidence
- File IDs to reference when uploaded
